sloka: वानराश्च महावीर्या विंशतिः कामरूपिणः ।सुग्रीवप्रमुखा राममुपासन्ते महौजसः ।। ७.३७.१९ ॥
transliteration: vānarāśca mahāvīryā viṁśatiḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।sugrīvapramukhā rāmamupāsante mahaujasaḥ ।। 7.37.19 ॥

translations.english: Twenty greatly valorous and powerful monkeys, led by Sugriva, who can assume any form at will, serve Rama.
